card.name: Modifier words before lab or fracture terms
card.fires_on: Descriptive modifier words that come just before a lab value or injury term, such as 'fasting' before serum glucose, 'asymptomatic' before enzyme rises, and 'low' before trauma or energy fractures.

modes.label: Fasting glucose
modes.description: The word fasting (or the start of it) in the statin warning about HbA1c and fasting serum glucose.
modes.example: Increases in HbA1c and<< fasting>> serum glucose levels have been reported with H

modes.label: Asymptomatic lab rises
modes.description: The middle of 'asymptomatic' before an enzyme or transaminase elevation.
modes.example: an increased incidence of asympt<<omatic>> creatine phosphokinase (CPK

modes.label: Low-trauma fracture
modes.description: Words in 'low trauma' or 'low-energy' before fracture.
modes.example: a history of a low<< trauma>> fracture or risk factors for osteoporosis

card.plain: It marks a qualifier like fasting or asymptomatic that sits right before a lab result or fracture term.
